title: Sandbox
description: 分镜与终端离线剧本相同：同一轮写出 .tmp/s04/note.md、读回、尝试 ../s04_outside.txt、再用 shell 写入 .tmp/s04/shell.txt。默认 workspace-write：界内放行、越界拒绝。终端不读你的提示词；这里也不是在跑 code.ts。 / Same storyboard as the terminal offline demo: one turn writes .tmp/s04/note.md, reads it back, tries ../s04_outside.txt, then shell-writes .tmp/s04/shell.txt. Default workspace-write allows inside and refuses the escape. The script ignores your prompt; this player is not live code.ts.

steps.content: Create a notes file in a scratch folder and read it back
steps.annotation: User sends a task. Offline mode ignores the text and plays a fixed script.

steps.content: turn 1: 4 function_call items in one output — write / read / ../ escape / shell write
steps.annotation: Fan-out from s02 still applies. What is new: sandboxedDispatch wraps every call before the handler runs.
isInside(workspace, .tmp/s04/note.md) is true, so dispatch runs.
Allowed calls still go through TOOL_HANDLERS[name], same as s02.
Reads never write. Allowed under every sandbox_mode.
The inside write is visible — the file exists.
One level up: the path resolves outside the workspace.

steps.content: sandbox: mode=workspace-write  refuse — write outside workspace
steps.annotation: The teaching sandbox is a path check. Real Codex uses Seatbelt / Landlock in the kernel.

steps.content: Error: blocked by sandbox_mode=workspace-write: write outside workspace: …/s04_outside.txt
steps.annotation: Refusal is not a crash: an error function_call_output is fed back and the loop continues.
A mutating shell command whose path stays inside the workspace.
workspace-write allows writes inside the launch directory, including via shell.

steps.content: Inside writes landed under .tmp/s04/. The ../ escape was blocked by sandbox_mode=workspace-write, so s04_outside.txt was never created. Same calls under read-only would refuse every write; under danger-full-access the escape would run.
steps.annotation: No function_call items → loop stops. Same ending as the terminal offline script.
